payload.summary: Six dictionary source pages need a browser read: four AIHW, a WA Health PDF, the recovery framework
payload.detail: aihw.gov.au returned HTTP 403 to this session for the alcohol and other drug treatment glossary, the suicide and self-harm monitoring glossary, ambulance attendances, and opioid agonist therapy in the prisons report. AIHW is already registered and ledger-eligible, so a release date is the only thing missing for all four. The WA Aboriginal Health Standardised Titles List is a PDF whose date needs the document itself. The national framework for recovery-oriented mental health services needs its title-page publisher and date, because the site index returns 2011 with a Victorian Department of Health attribution that conflicts with the recorded publisher. Separately, meteor.aihw.gov.au is not in GOVERNED_SOURCE_HOSTS, which blocks three NOCC metadata records regardless of date.
